title: Fix every violation of one ESLint rule

params.name: rule
params.description: The ESLint rule ID to fix.

preconditions: ESLint is installed locally and configured with the rule enabled.
At least one violation of the rule at the baseline.

criteria.pass: ESLint reports zero violations of the rule, no new disable comments or ESLint config changes, and the test script passes.
criteria.partial: Violations dropped but not to zero, or they reached zero by disabling the rule, or tests fail.
criteria.fail: The violation count did not drop, or ESLint could not run.
